officialSourcesReviewed.finding: RRF combines ranked lists using reciprocal rank contributions, commonly with k=60, without relying on incompatible raw score scales.
Non-persistent browser contexts do not write browsing data to disk and should be explicitly closed.
Untrusted crawling should run as a separate non-root user with process reaping and sandbox isolation.
Browser and crawler settings expose bounded cache, wait, page and output behavior; caller scripts remain disabled here.
Meaningful user-agent identity, request limits and API etiquette remain mandatory.
Public JSON APIs require no key and are updated throughout the day, subject to SEC automated-access policy.
The Census API exposes public statistical and geographic data under its documented query and terms controls.
Unauthenticated public-data requests are limited to 60 per hour and rate-limit headers/backoff must be honored.
Public unauthenticated product endpoints exist, while session, customer, checkout and write behavior is out of scope.
